attribution_limits: All variants are isolated diagnostics. No estimator, receiver metadata, or ingress candidate is accepted or landed.
Passing shrink or capacity cells do not override the retained physically valid reverse-compression rejection or long-path failure.
No wire schema changed. Receiver diagnostics model zero additional encoded metadata bytes and are information-only optimistic bounds.
Raw logs, traces, source, overlays, binaries, commands, environment, local paths, and synthetic identities are excluded; normalized readings, outcomes, and hashes only are retained.
findings: Safe ACK-arrival service credit alone does not close the shrinking 64 KiB cell. Root separately fixed static 256 KiB cells and low-rate shared feedback; those are different experiments.
First-offer rollover fixes its direct partial-train root, but both v1 and v2 fail the unchanged shrink model. A blanket low-flight/gap guard was previously rejected and is not revived here.
Receiver-local ingress timestamps still include source-limited gaps between ACK-selected checkpoints. A pair-specific offered-rate eligibility filter was needed for this prototype's shrink success.
With the same pair consumer and eligibility filter, receiver-ingress timing and sender ACK timing minus field12 both pass shrink and the six original capacity transitions. Raw ACK timing does not.

Corrected-ACK timing is rejected: an actual-worker, physically possible reverse-compression schedule with 50 ms propagation in each direction produces 64.38 GB/s. max(corrected span, matched offer span) is already applied and cannot help when the source offered the whole flight at one timestamp.
The same stronger reverse fixture passes with the ordinary sampler and with receiver-local ingress pairs, for both zero and 50 ms receiver delay.

Receiver ingress plus integrated recovery v3 still fails the unchanged 1.2 s growth gate: 85.2036267 versus 95.7781333 Mb/s, intervals 88.96512/85.01248/81.63328, zero total and measured drops. No full long-path fix is claimed.
protocol_and_attribution_limits: No wire schema changed. Receiver ingress diagnostics model zero extra encoded metadata bytes; results are optimistic information-only bounds, not a production wire-performance estimate.

Receiver ledger snapshots are delivered only by an actual ACK for the named message; no live receiver lookup or capacity oracle feeds the consumer. Original outer encoded length is captured before decryption/decoding.

Receiver ledger and pair history are bounded test-only prototypes. Production reset/dedup lifetime, stale metadata, encryption overhead, mixed carrier and multi-lane reorder contracts are not fully validated.

The original alias fixture uses variable nonnegative reverse residence, not two realizations of the fixed finite-link model. The stronger reverse fixture explicitly satisfies 50 ms propagation lower bounds in both directions.
The offered-rate eligibility rule is still provisional. Passing six capacity changes does not establish all genuine slow-path, source-idle, compression or hold invariants.
Historical host, duplex, long-tail retry and separate shared-feedback failures are not attributed to this small-window root.
Original gates, warmup, measurement periods, budgets, per-flow and drop checks remain unchanged. Every failed model and excluded fixture/harness diagnostic is retained.
scope: Small shrinking-window feedback sampling, actual sender/receiver timing ambiguity, offered-rate eligibility, and unchanged capacity/long-RTT controls.
status_from_handoff: Frozen isolated diagnostics only. No estimator or receiver metadata candidate is accepted or landed.
